thread:
Anya (product): quick idea 1		build a 'gracepath orchestration' for catalog entries so migrations are predictable and observable. want to capture signal set, automation steps, and a pricing option for assisted migrations. thoughts?

Ravi (eng-rt): nice. start with signals: request-level semantic-drift, top-1 token delta, p95 generation length, hallucination-rate (customer tests), and error-rate. need to define measurement windows (1h/24h/7d).

Lina (cs): customers care about semantic changes. propose a "prompt-suite" attachable to pins; run baseline + candidate and report BLEU/ROUGE-ish + embedding cosine delta. small sample first (100 queries) then expand.

Jorge (sre): telemetry hooks: we need a migration-health dashboard + alert thresholds. propose auto-alert if embedding-cosine-drop > 0.08 or hallucination-rate increases by > 3pp. also require CPU/GPU mem steady-state across canary.

Marta (sales): pricing idea: include a free self-serve migration runner, and a paid "cutover concierge" starting $10k for enterprise (4h hands-on + SLA guardrails). will validate with two pilot customers.

Anya (product): orchestration flow (rough): 1) opt-in pin window opens; 2) attach prompt-suite; 3) run dry-run (no traffic) -> semantic report; 4) staged canary (synthetic + live) with split steps; 5) full cutover or rollback; 6) post-cutover report + changelog.

Ravi (eng-rt): need a migration job spec. sketch config below for the dry-run + canary phases:

```json
{
  "job_id": "mj-20240401-01",
  "phases": [
    {"name":"dry-run","traffic":0,"synthetic":true,"samples":200},
    {"name":"canary-1","traffic":5,"synthetic":50,"duration_mins":120},
    {"name":"canary-2","traffic":20,"synthetic":0,"duration_mins":180}
  ],
  "metrics": {
    "semantic_cosine_drop": 0.08,
    "hallucination_increase_pp": 3,
    "p99_latency_increase_pct": 25
  },
  "auto_rollback": true
}
```

Lina (cs): love the job spec. add per-customer tolerance overrides (enterprises can set weaker/stronger thresholds). also include a "guided remediation" checklist when a metric fails.

Jorge (sre): ops detail: require ephemeral canary routing ids and immutable snapshots of model weights used for audit. also circuit-breaker: if any instance restarts >3 in 15m, abort.

migration-bot: created MIGRATE-1187: migration-runner baseline infra ticket, assigned to @Ravi. :robot_face:

Anya (product): decision asks: (A) accept signal set and thresholds proto? (B) consent to add per-customer overrides? (C) approve migration assistance product + pilot pricing?

Ravi (eng-rt): +1 A/B, can scope infra changes next sprint.

Lina (cs): +1 A/B/C for pilot; CS will surface 2 customers for pilot runs.

Jorge (sre): +1 A/B, will prepare dashboard templates and SLO doc.

Marta (sales): +1 C for pilot. will feed back on pricing after pilot.

Anya (product): thanks all 1		I'll draft the RFC and attach the migration-job schema + UI mocks. will ping for a short sync after RFC.
